## Expand two binomials using FOIL {#foil}

Multiply each term in the first bracket by each term in the second. FOIL gives an order for the four products.

:::::: {.example-pair}

::::: {.model}

<h3>Worked example</h3>

$(2x+3)(x+4)$

::: {.fragment}

[First]{.annotation} $(2x)(x)=2x^2$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Outer]{.annotation} $(2x)(4)=8x$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Inner]{.annotation} $(3)(x)=3x$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Last]{.annotation} $(3)(4)=12$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Collect the two terms in $x$.]{.annotation}

$2x^2+8x+3x+12=2x^2+11x+12$

:::

:::::

::::: {.paper}

::: {.fragment}

<h3>Your turn</h3>

$(2x+3)(x-4)$

Which two products change sign? Write all four products, then simplify.

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Check your working]{.annotation}

The outer and last products change sign.

$=2x^2-8x+3x-12$

$=2x^2-5x-12$

:::
